title: Volo-Volo market vendors’ strike and gathering outside Moroni city hall
reason: The reported gathering and strike occurred on 30 January 2023, before the assigned February start month.
notes: Comores Infos body lines 45–53 reports women vendors gathered outside the city hall and criticized fee decisions, but gives no count. No evidence of continuation into February was found in the captured February queries; it is not moved into this month.
